title: SCX: Stateless KV-Cache Encoding for Cloud-Scale Confidential Transformer Serving
motivation: 现有机密计算方法(密码学/TEE/访问控制)在隐私与效率间存在根本矛盾,大模型推理延迟难以接受
problem_framing: 将云端KV-cache设计为无法独立完成下一个token预测的状态,通过用户控制密钥锁定中间状态
key_insight: 利用Transformer前后向传播的顺序性,仅保留首尾层密钥即可锁定推理,中间层密钥可共享降低通信复杂度
method_signature: 三阶段编码+令牌置换+冗余嵌入+拉普拉斯噪声,实现O(T+L)通信复杂度
evaluation_criteria: lossless inference quality, attack resistance (brute-force/LLM-assisted/fitting), latency <50ms for 7B
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Multi-GPU部署时需与NVIDIA CC配合使用,存在额外all_gather通信开销
evidence_for_taste: existing solutions are insufficient to resist certain known attack methods
This design reduces the communication complexity from O(T·L) to O(T+L)
these methods often suffer from significant computational and communication overheads
can incur non-negligible latency in distributed inference scenarios
thinking_moves: 将隐私问题重新frame为通信复杂度问题,利用模型结构的顺序性破局
把攻击防御映射到差分隐私理论,给出形式化的概率上界证明
区分prefill和generation两阶段分别设计密钥策略,利用自回归特性
从已有技术(cryptography/TEE/access control)的根本局限出发寻找新 tradeoff空间
